title: Pass / Fail Evaluation (2 Stages)
description:
Practice writing if / else statements across 2 stages:
1. Create variable score1 = 82. If score1 >= 60, print "Student 1: Passed", else print "Student 1: Failed".
2. Create variable score2 = 45. If score2 >= 60, print "Student 2: Passed", else print "Student 2: Failed".
